concepts.def: Clocks run slower in stronger gravitational fields.

walkthroughs.body_html: Clocks deep in a gravitational well run slower than clocks far away. GPS satellites correct for both special and gravitational time dilation — without it, positions would drift by km per day.
Predicted by Einstein in 1916, gravitational waves were directly detected by LIGO in 2015 from a binary black hole merger. The 2017 Nobel Prize recognised the achievement.
Stephen Hawking showed in 1974 that quantum effects near the horizon make black holes emit thermal Hawking radiation. Smaller black holes are hotter and evaporate faster.
